I replied to Hollis in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025. It's the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing when it scans the bill-of-lading barcode. Hollis is in that channel, so he could see it himself.
- **Right account:** Tobias first called it "TP", which caused some mix-up with another customer, Tansley Parcel. He then confirmed the ticket is for Tansleigh Packaging.
- **Current status unknown:** I didn't find any later update on the ticket in the channels I checked. I said so in the reply rather than guess.

A ticket number is an operational detail, and Hollis leads the Central team, so no approval was needed to share it.
